title: Shenjinhuoxue Mixture Attenuates Inflammation, Pain, and Cartilage Degeneration by Inhibiting TLR-4 and NF-kappaB Activation in Rats with Osteoarthritis: A Synergistic Combination of Multitarget Active Phytochemicals.
authors: Ma, Xiaoqin; Hao, Chenxia; Zhang, Zhaokang; Jiang, Huiting; Zhang, Weixia; Huang, Jingjing; Chen, Xiaofei; Yang, Wanhua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过抑制TLR-4/NF-kB通路治疗骨关节炎，涉及蛋白-小分子对接而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA), a highly prevalent chronic joint disease, involves a complex network of inflammatory mediators that not only triggers pain and cartilage degeneration but also accelerates disease progression. Traditional Chinese medicinal shenjinhuoxue mixture (SHM) shows anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects against OA with remarkable clinical efficacy. This study explored the mechanism underlying anti-OA properties of SHM and evaluated its efficacy and safety via in vivo experiments. Through network pharmacology and published literature, we identified the key active phytochemicals in SHM, including beta-sitosterol, oleanolic acid, licochalcone A, quercetin, isorhamnetin, kaempferol, morusin, lupeol, and pinocembrin; the pivotal targets of which are TLR-4 and NF-kappaB, eliciting anti-OA activity. These phytochemicals can enter the active pockets of TLR-4 and NF-kappaB with docking score </= -3.86 kcal/mol, as shown in molecular docking models. By using surface plasmon resonance assay, licochalcone A and oleanolic acid were found to have good TLR-4-binding affinity. In OA rats, oral SHM at mid and high doses (8.72 g/kg and 26.2 g/kg) over 6 weeks significantly alleviated mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia (P < 0.0001). Accordingly, the expression of inflammatory mediators (TLR-4, interleukin (IL-) 1 receptor-associated kinase 1 (IRAK1), NF-kappaB-p65, tumor necrosis factor (TNF-) alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta), receptor activator of the NF-kappaB ligand (RANKL), and transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 (TRPV1) in the synovial and cartilage tissue of OA rats was significantly decreased (P < 0.05). Moreover, pathological observation illustrated amelioration of cartilage degeneration and joint injury. In chronic toxicity experiment of rats, SHM at 60 mg/kg demonstrated the safety. SHM had an anti-inflammatory effect through a synergistic combination of active phytochemicals to attenuate pain and cartilage degeneration by inhibiting TLR-4 and NF-kappaB activation. This study provided the experimental foundation for the development of SHM into a more effective dosage form or new drugs for OA treatment.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种高发的慢性关节疾病，涉及复杂的炎症介质网络，不仅引发疼痛和软骨退变，还加速疾病进展。中药伸筋活血合剂（SHM）对OA具有抗炎和镇痛作用，临床疗效显著。本研究通过体内实验探讨了SHM抗OA特性的机制，并评估了其疗效和安全性。通过网络药理学和已发表文献，我们鉴定了SHM中的关键活性植物化学物质，包括β-谷甾醇、齐墩果酸、甘草查尔酮A、槲皮素、异鼠李素、山柰酚、桑酮、羽扇豆醇和松属素；其关键靶点为TLR-4和NF-kappaB，从而发挥抗OA活性。分子对接模型显示，这些植物化学物质能以对接分数≤ -3.86 kcal/mol进入TLR-4和NF-kappaB的活性口袋。通过表面等离子体共振实验，发现甘草查尔酮A和齐墩果酸对TLR-4具有良好的结合亲和力。在OA大鼠中，口服中、高剂量（8.72 g/kg和26.2 g/kg）的SHM持续6周，显著缓解了机械性和热痛觉过敏（P < 0.0001）。相应地，OA大鼠滑膜和软骨组织中炎症介质（TLR-4、白细胞介素（IL-）1受体相关激酶1（IRAK1）、NF-kappaB-p65、肿瘤坏死因子（TNF-）α、IL-6和IL-1β）、NF-kappaB配体受体激活剂（RANKL）和瞬时受体电位香草酸亚型1（TRPV1）的表达显著降低（P < 0.05）。此外，病理观察显示软骨退变和关节损伤得到改善。在大鼠慢性毒性实验中，SHM在60 mg/kg剂量下表现出安全性。SHM通过活性植物化学物质的协同组合发挥抗炎作用，通过抑制TLR-4和NF-kappaB激活来减轻疼痛和软骨退变。本研究为将SHM开发成更有效的剂型或治疗OA的新药提供了实验基础。
